name: Agent Transaction Protocol
core_invariant: Any protocol-relevant state change must occur through a valid state transition.
cross_domain_rule: external claims acquire effect only through destination-policy recognition
state_domain: defined kernel term: one state space, one ledger, one policy store, one rule vocabulary
policy_representation: documents held in state at policy/<id>; the state version is the policy version; the rule vocabulary is interpreter code
policy_amendment_rule: by itself under a version pin, or by policy/authority; never by a bare transition
decision_attachment: evidence with about === proposalHash, gathered automatically so a proposal cannot hide a judgment aimed at it
